subject: Renewal: SOC 2 re-attestation sequencing + seat uplift (terms & evidence)
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@bluepeak.ai>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.ai
Date: 2026-08-25T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal / SOC 2 re-attest sequencing and seat increase

Hi Camila,

Hope you're well — our renewal for BluePeak with Redwood is coming up (expires 2026-09-15) and we have two items that need coordination from your side:

1) SOC 2 re-attestation: we need confirmation of Redwood's attestation window and an evidence upload schedule (our auditors want a dump of system logs and the SOC 2 evidence binder by Oct 10).

2) Seats & retention: we're planning a 50% seat uplift across our dev/staging queues (from 120 to 180) and need to confirm any impact on log retention costs. We want retention extended to 365 days for auditability.

Can you send a proposed sequencing (who does what, by when) and an updated estimate for the retention uplift and committed capacity? Procurement copied here will need any contract amendment or pricing note.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Compliance, BluePeak Analytics
elena.rossi@bluepeak.ai

From: camila.reyes@redwood.ai <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@bluepeak.ai
Date: 2026-08-26T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / SOC 2 re-attest sequencing and seat increase

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Quick proposal below; attaching a checklist and retention matrix for numbers.

High-level plan (proposed):
- Week 1 (Aug 26–Sep 2): Redwood provides SOC 2 evidence checklist and map to BluePeak's auditor expectations (attachment: soc2-evidence-checklist.xlsx).
- Week 2 (Sep 3–Sep 9): Audit evidence bulk export — logs + config snapshots staged to your secure bucket. We’ll provide MD5 manifests and transfer instructions.
- Week 3 (Sep 10–Sep 16): Validation window; auditor can pull samples. If anything gaps, we do a fast follow on Sep 17–20.

Seat & retention pricing notes (summary):
- Seat uplift: 120 -> 180 (50%): recommended path is a 3-month committed burst, then convert to annual uplift at renewal signature. Ben will share the delta pricing.
- Retention: extending to 365 days will increase storage/ingestion costs; rough estimate attached (retention-matrix-365days.pdf).

Contract/terms: I drafted a short amendment to capture the temporary burst and the retention term — see redwood-renewal-amendment-v2.docx. If that looks good we can route to DocuSign.

Next steps / asks for BluePeak:
- Confirm auditor contact and preferred access pattern (S3 role vs. signed link).
- Procurement: please confirm whether you need a PO or signed amendment first.

Ben / Karthik — can you confirm the cost delta and the SLA impacts for the uplift/retention and confirm whether we can guarantee the evidence export timeline?

Camila
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Following up with the numbers — copying the brief here and attaching the retention matrix.

Cost delta (estimates):
- Seat uplift (short-term burst, 3 months): incremental commit fee = $12,600/mo (covers reserved capacity overhead). One-time pro-rated charge if we start before the renewal date.
- Ongoing (if converted to annual): annual contract uplift = +$127k/year.
- Retention to 365d: incremental storage & egress estimate = ~$8k/month (depends on ingest velocity); I gave a conservative bucket in retention-matrix-365days.pdf.

SLA/throughput impact: we can honor existing latency SLOs for the 50% uplift if the burst is scheduled (we'll reserve GPUs in a dedicated pool). If BluePeak wants immediate continuous uplift without a scheduled ramp, we advise a 48–72 hour provisioning lead.

Evidence export timeline: confirmed — we can produce the evidence bundle and S3 staging by Sep 9 if BluePeak grants access roles by Sep 1. Karthik, can infra ops confirm export job windows?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: retention-matrix-365days.pdf

Hi all — infra ops note:

- Evidence export: we will run a staged export job that snapshots config, audit logs, and service-level traces. Export window: Sep 4–6, deliver to your secured S3 staging bucket (we'll provide presigned URLs and a cross-account role if preferred).
- Log retention change: changing retention to 365d is a config flip plus a backfill migration for recent compressed archives. Backfill throughput depends on total historical volume; for BluePeak we estimate 18–24 hours of migration work (no downtime).
- Provisioning cadence: to guarantee SLOs for the 50% uplift, we must schedule dedicated pool capacity 72 hours in advance. If procurement signs amendment by Sep 2 we can provision for Sep 6.

I'll create a short runbook for the export and share a drive link within 24 hours.

—Karthik

3) Retention: config change to 365 days accepted — expected backfill migration 24 hours (non-disruptive). Cost estimate: ~$8k/month, will itemize on the amendment.

4) Contract: I've attached redwood-renewal-amendment-v2.docx. If procurement confirms PO-first vs. signature-first we’ll align billing — DocuSign link is ready once legal confirms redlines.

Next steps for BluePeak:
- Confirm auditor contact & access preference by Sep 1.
- Procurement: confirm PO vs signed amendment cadence.
- If agreed, reply-all with authorization to start provisioning.
